chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid reported to me from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali — may Allah have mercy on him — from Abu Ja'far al-Baqir Muhammad ibn Ali, peace be upon them both. He said: I heard him say:

"Whoever has four traits in him, his Islam is complete, his faith is strengthened, his sins are purged from him, and he meets his Lord while He is pleased with him — even if he had sins from his head to his feet, Allah would remove them from him. They are: fulfilling what one pledges to Allah upon oneself, truthfulness of tongue with the people, modesty from what is shameful in the sight of Allah and the people, and good character with one's family and the people.

And four traits — whoever among the believers has them, Allah will house him in the highest of 'Illiyyin, in chambers above chambers, in a place of utmost honour: one who shelters an orphan and cares for him, being like a compassionate father to him; one who has mercy on the weak, helping and providing for him; one who spends on his parents, being gentle with them and dutiful to them without causing them grief; and one who does not treat his servant harshly, helping him in what he assigns to him and not overburdening him with what he cannot bear."

key_terms.أعلى عليين: 'Illiyyin — the highest rank in Paradise, mentioned in Quran 83:18
key_terms.حسن الخلق: good character — refined moral conduct with family and society
key_terms.صدق اللسان: truthfulness of tongue — sincerity and honesty in speech
key_terms.كمل إسلامه: his Islam is complete — attaining perfection in submission to God

ai.seo_question: What are the four traits that complete Islam and the four that earn the highest Paradise according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) teaches that four virtues complete one's Islam and purge all sins — fulfilling divine pledges, truthfulness, modesty, and good character — while four additional virtues of compassionate social action earn the highest place in Paradise. This teaching, delivered to his close companion Abu Hamza al-Thumali, addresses the practical ethics expected of believers in their daily family and social interactions.
